_doc: Representative standards table for the spool engine. Nothing here is a sealed-design value. Every entry says where it came from and how well it was verified. 'unverified' = assumed/representative or recalled and NOT retrieved from the cited document in this session.
label: representative — verify against submittals, not sealed design

citations.SMACNA_HVAC_DCS: SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards - Metal and Flexible (Ch. 4 reinforcement/joints, Ch. 5 hangers and supports). Governs hanger spacing and sizes. Table values NOT retrieved in P2; no table in it was confirmed to give a maximum shop/handling section length.
citations.SMACNA_SEISMIC: SMACNA Seismic Restraint Manual: Guidelines for Mechanical Systems (ANSI/SMACNA 001-2008 3rd ed.; 4th ed. 2025). Brace spacing depends on Seismic Hazard Level (A/B/C); values NOT retrieved in P2.
citations.ASME_B36_10M: ASME B36.10M welded and seamless wrought steel pipe: OD and plain-end weight per foot. Table NOT retrieved in P2 (search could not confirm the figures).
citations.WINNIPEG_230529: City of Winnipeg spec section 230529 (hanger spacing for steel pipe) - a municipal spec, NOT MSS SP-69: https://legacy.winnipeg.ca/finance/findata/matmgt/documents/2012/45-2012/45-2012_Specification_230529.pdf

sheetWeightLbPerSf.source: HERCULES_STEEL_CHART (26, 22, 20 ga); 24 ga from mepacademy.com galvanized weight chart. Whether G90 coating weight is included was not confirmed.

maxSpoolLenFt.source: NO SMACNA TABLE CITED. Representative shop/handling limits chosen for the model (typical flanged rectangular sections 4-5 ft; spiral 10 ft; steel pipe ~20 ft random length). Replace with the fabricator's or the project's handling limit.

ductHorizontalMaxSpacingFt.source: SMACNA_HVAC_DCS Ch. 5 governs; 'not exceeding 10 ft' is from secondary study-guide text only.

pipeHorizontalMaxSpacingM.source: WINNIPEG_230529 steel pipe water, NPS -> metres (2 in 3.0 m, 4 in 4.2 m, 6 in 5.1 m). Not MSS SP-69.

verticalOnePerFloor.source: assumed riser clamp at each floor

ductSpacingFt.source: SMACNA_SEISMIC governs; figures recalled, not retrieved

pipeSpacingFt.source: SMACNA_SEISMIC governs; figures recalled, not retrieved

HVAC-DUCT-RECT-001.source: assumed sizes; gauge from lab ductStandards PC2 (not checked against SMACNA)

HVAC-PIPE-HYD-001.source: ASME_B36_10M Sch 40 recalled, not retrieved; NPS mix assumed
